title: Elderly Farmer Couple Outdoors, 1930s Rural Americana Snapshot Photo
description: An outdoor portrait of an older rural couple seated closely together on what appears to be their homestead. The husband wears denim bib overalls over a collared work shirt, sporting a mustache, while the wife wears spectacles pulled up on her head, a patterned floral blouse, and a dark skirt or apron. The background reveals overgrown garden vegetation, wooden wheels or spools, a hand pump or standpipe, and dense trees under bright natural sunlight, capturing working-class rural American life during the early 20th century.
